document.about: An invented list of service contracts printed to PDF by headless Chrome on macOS (fixtures/chrome-table-thin-section-band.html): 6 point type, each region's contracts under a dark band holding its name in 5.5 point type between rules 7.5 points apart.

notes: Reprint with: Chrome --headless --no-pdf-header-footer --print-to-pdf=chrome-table-thin-section-band.pdf chrome-table-thin-section-band.html, then update the sha256.
The band's height in the HTML (6.5pt) prints 7.5 points between its rules with the borders; taller than a cell's height, eight points, it was always a row.

checks.issue: The band `Northern Region (NR)` was no row of its own: its rules stand closer than a cell's height, and it ran into the row under it (`Northern Region (NR) Grounds maintenance`).
